_howTo: Paste a YouTube link (any format: watch?v=, youtu.be/, shorts/) into "youtube".
For images, put the file in backend/public/media/ and write just the file name in "thumbnail", e.g. "full-body-basics.jpg". A full https:// image URL also works.
Then run: npm run db:seed  (safe to re-run; it only updates content, demo accounts are recreated).
Leave a value empty to keep the placeholder.
